# Open Image Denoise headers

Unmodified `oidn.h`, `config.h` and `LICENSE.txt` from Intel Open Image Denoise
2.5.1, https://github.com/RenderKit/oidn/releases/tag/v2.5.1.
The headers retain their original copyright and Apache 2.0 license.

Windows CPU runtime archive: `oidn-2.5.1.x64.windows.zip`.
SHA256: `f11f91bc072a5e3a564515724cb72ab8fcfbc445c84a84c197ff9b16cc01396f`.
See `docs/guide/photo-rendering.md` for runtime installation. OmniSim loads it
optionally, by absolute path, and retains an edge-aware filter when unavailable.
